class.name: FmodPerformanceData
class.brief_description: A snapshot of FMOD CPU and memory performance metrics.
class.description:
FmodPerformanceData is a read-only snapshot of FMOD's internal performance counters. Obtain one from [method FmodServer.get_performance_data].
CPU values are percentages of one update interval; memory values are byte counts. [codeblock] var perf = FmodServer.get_performance_data() print("Studio CPU: ", perf.studio, "%") print("Memory used: ", perf.currently_allocated, " bytes") [/codeblock]

method.name: get_convolution1
method.description: Returns CPU usage (%) for the first convolution reverb DSP unit.

method.name: get_convolution2
method.description: Returns CPU usage (%) for the second convolution reverb DSP unit.

method.name: get_currently_allocated
method.description: Returns the number of bytes currently allocated by the FMOD memory system.

method.name: get_dsp
method.description: Returns CPU usage (%) for the DSP mixing thread.

method.name: get_geometry
method.description: Returns CPU usage (%) for geometry processing (occlusion and obstruction).

method.name: get_max_allocated
method.description: Returns the peak number of bytes ever allocated by the FMOD memory system during this session.

method.name: get_other_bytes_read
method.description: Returns the number of bytes read from sources other than sample or stream data.

method.name: get_sample_bytes_read
method.description: Returns the number of bytes read from sample data storage this update.

method.name: get_stream
method.description: Returns CPU usage (%) for the streaming decode thread.

method.name: get_stream_bytes_read
method.description: Returns the number of bytes read from streaming audio sources this update.

method.name: get_studio
method.description: Returns CPU usage (%) for the FMOD Studio update thread.

method.name: get_update
method.description: Returns CPU usage (%) for the main FMOD update call.
